summary: Full E2E test of DealLinked CRM completed. Backend: 13/13 tests passed (Auth, Deals CRUD, Pipelines, Geocoding). Frontend: All core pages load and function correctly (Dashboard, Map, Pipeline, Contacts, Calendar, Team, Settings). Signup flow works with redirect to Dashboard. Map features working: satellite tiles load, Click to Add mode, Add Deal panel, address autocomplete. Deal creation requires location selection (by design). All navigation works between pages.

issues: Create Deal button disabled until location is selected - this is by design but users may not notice the requirement. The instruction text 'Search for an address above or click on the map to set location' helps.

critical_code_review_comments: Backend API is robust - all 13 test cases pass including auth, deals CRUD, pipelines, and geocoding
Frontend pages all load correctly with proper data-testid attributes
Map tile prefetching appears to be working (no blank areas observed)
Address autocomplete integrates with Radar.io correctly
All sidebar navigation links work correctly
seed_data_creation: Multiple test users created via UI during E2E testing
